title: Lightning Rasengan
body:
Syntax: perform lightning rasengan <target>

Description: A Lightning Rasengan that can paralyze.  Requires Lightning chakra nature. Base damage: 137-161. 25% chance to inflict paralyzed. Unlocks at level 40. Costs 38 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 7 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
